claims: Brock Lesnar was defeated by Oba Femi in 4:46.
The match opened Night Two of WrestleMania 42.
Night Two of WrestleMania 42 took place in Las Vegas.
Night Two of WrestleMania 42 took place on April 19, 2026.
Following the loss, Brock Lesnar removed his gloves and boots and left them in the center of the ring.
Leaving gloves and boots in the ring is a traditional sign of retirement in professional wrestling.
Reports from Yahoo Sports state that Brock Lesnar was visibly emotional.
Reports from Yahoo Sports state that Brock Lesnar shared a hug with his long-time manager Paul Heyman.
Reports from Yahoo Sports state that Brock Lesnar took in applause from the crowd.
Paul Heyman is Brock Lesnar's long-time manager.
The appearance was not explicitly billed as a retirement match beforehand.
Reports from USA Today and TMZ Sports indicate that the match was intended to be Brock Lesnar's final match.
Brock Lesnar is a former UFC heavyweight champion.
Brock Lesnar is a multiple-time WWE champion
